typing to search Home / Great Games Great Games Grand Theft Auto VI Comes to XBOX One and XBOX Series X|S Through XBOX Cloud Gaming on November 19 Team XBOX November 10, 2026 · 2 min read Grand Theft Auto VI , the most pre-ordered title of all time on the Microsoft Store, launches November 19. Considering the unprecedented demand, we encourage everyone to begin pre-loading as soon as possible to ensure you’re prepared for launch day. Grand Theft Auto VI will be playable on day one through XBOX Cloud Gaming on XBOX One and XBOX Series X|S, starting at 1am ET. That means more players can experience one of the most anticipated games of the year on the consoles they already own. The game uses XBOX Series S graphics settings when cloud-streamed with XBOX Cloud Gaming. Here’s how you can play: XBOX Series X: Play natively with the best XBOX console experience, available now to pre-install . XBOX Series S: The most affordable way to play GTA VI natively on XBOX, available now to pre-install . XBOX One: Stream Grand Theft Auto VI through XBOX Cloud Gaming on the XBOX One. We’re excited to bring Grand Theft Auto VI to more XBOX players at launch, and we will also be adding more titles from Rockstar Games to XBOX Cloud Gaming including Grand Theft Auto V , Red Dead Redemption 2 , and more in the coming months. Starting November 11, players in supported markets can buy cloud playtime to stream supported games without a Game Pass subscription. Streaming for Grand Theft Auto VI begins at 1am ET on November 19. Pre-order Grand Theft Auto VI today on the Microsoft Store . Cloud gaming availability, purchasing options, supported devices, account eligibility, and features may vary by market and device. Grand Theft Auto VI must be purchased separately. Grand Theft Auto VI is a single-player experience. Vice City, USA. Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them. But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida — forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive. This purchase includes the Ultimate Edition Upgrade with exclusive in-game bonuses for Grand Theft Auto VI, available to Jason and Lucia across their story, with new items uncovered behind each chapter. ULTIMATE EDITION UPGRADE Welcome to Leonida, the state where anything goes. Seize everything this massive world has to offer with an exclusive collection of premium vehicles, weapons, apparel, and action threaded across all aspects of Jason and Lucia’s story: – ’95 GROTTI CHEETAH: Grotti's signature mid '90s sports car, complete with a retro-futuristic livery to punctuate later-stage action. – HAWK & LITTLE MORGAN REVOLVERS: His and hers versions of this powerful revolver with classic stylings sourced from the Vercetti Estate. – PERSONALIZED WEAPON VARIANTS: Personalized sidearms with detailed engravings for Jason's Girardi ES9 pistol and Lucia's Klose K17 pistol. – VICE CITY STYLE: Whether poolside or side by side, Jason and Lucia can look the part with exclusive outfits, hairstyles, tattoos, and more. – JASON’S SAFEHOUSE VEHICLES: Switch gears and soak up the sun in an Army fatigue-tinged Dinka Enduro motorcycle or Crest Kayak. – GANADO RETRO BUILD: Inject muscle and classic stylings into Jason's well-worn Vapid Ganado low-riding pickup with exclusive mods. – SHITZU SQUALO: This pink and blue Squalo watercraft is open-ocean-ready with an explosives-laden weapons crate. – '67 VAPID DOMINATOR BUGGY & GARAGE: A Mud Club monster offering impressive off-road handling. Store it at the Paradise Garage in Watson Bay. – GOODTIME GEAR: A collection of apparel and accessories inspired by the hit TV show character, Macca the Gator. – PTT YOUNGIN$ COMPOUND: Raid this gang compound and escape safely to score special items and distinct contraband. – CLASSIC CAR COLLECTION: Track down project cars and revitalize them in this special commission from eccentric collector and local fixer, Wyman. Special Destinations Only Open for Business with the Ultimate Edition: – RIDEOUT CUSTOMS: Transform vehicles into works of art with detailed interiors, exquisite rims, and donk stylings. – SARA'S UNISEX SALON: Get signature salon styles, including facial hair for Jason and makeup and nails for Lucia. – STOCK 305: Style unique and exclusive looks for Jason and Lucia at Stockyard’s premier destination for elevated streetwear. – ELECTRIC FANG TATTOO: Choose from over 50 signature tattoos for both Jason and Lucia — all designed by the artist collective FAILE. – ONE-EYED WILLIE’S: Lake Leonida’s storied mod shop, specializing in off-road modifications and hand-painted automotive artistry.
